Fuzo TravelEase Universal Travel Adapter with Type C & USB Ports

The Fuzo TravelEase Universal Travel Adapter with Type C & USB Ports is a premium, all-in-one charging solution designed for modern travelers who demand reliability, safety, and global compatibility. Built to support 150+ countries, this universal travel adapter works seamlessly across destinations using US, EU, UK, AU, and IN plug standards, making it the perfect companion for international travel, business trips, vacations, and digital nomads.

Whether you are traveling for work or leisure, the Fuzo TravelEase Universal Travel Adapter with Type C & USB Ports ensures uninterrupted charging for smartphones, tablets, power banks, Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, and other USB-powered electronics. With multiple charging ports and an intelligent internal design, it eliminates the need to carry multiple chargers or plug converters.

Global Compatibility Across 150+ Countries

This universal adapter supports plug types commonly used in the USA, Europe, the United Kingdom, Australia, and India. From international airports and hotels to offices and homes abroad, the adapter ensures smooth power access wherever you go. Its compact yet powerful design makes it suitable for both short trips and extended global travel.

Fast & Efficient Charging with Type C & USB Ports

Equipped with Type C and USB ports, the Fuzo TravelEase adapter allows you to charge multiple devices simultaneously. The Type C port ensures faster and more stable power delivery, while the USB ports provide universal compatibility for a wide range of gadgets. This makes it an ideal travel charger for mobile phones, laptops, cameras, and accessories.

  • Multiple output ports for simultaneous charging
  • Type C port for fast and efficient charging
  • USB ports compatible with most digital devices

Enhanced Safety with In-Built Fuse & Automatic Locking Mechanism

Safety is a priority in the Fuzo TravelEase Universal Travel Adapter with Type C & USB Ports. It features an in-built fuse that protects your devices from over-current, short circuits, and voltage fluctuations. The automatic locking mechanism ensures the selected plug stays firmly in place, preventing accidental slips or exposure to live pins.

  • In-built fuse for advanced electrical protection
  • Automatic locking system for secure usage
  • Designed to meet international safety standards

Premium Rubberised Finish for Durability & Comfort

Crafted with a Rubberised premium finish, this universal offers excellent grip, durability, and resistance to everyday wear. The soft-touch exterior not only enhances aesthetics but also protects the adapter from minor impacts during travel. Its sleek and compact form fits easily into backpacks, cabin luggage, or laptop bags.

Ideal for International Travelers & Professionals

The is ideal for frequent flyers, corporate travelers, students studying abroad, and anyone who travels internationally. Its universal design reduces clutter and provides a dependable power solution for global use, making it one of the most essential international travel accessories.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Supports US, EU, UK, AU & IN plug types
  • Works in 150+ countries worldwide
  • Type C & USB ports for versatile charging
  • In-built fuse for device safety
  • Automatic locking mechanism for secure plug usage
  • Rubberised premium finish for durability and grip
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design

Choose the for a safe, efficient, and globally compatible charging experience. Designed for today’s connected traveler, it combines performance, protection, and premium build quality into one essential travel accessory.
